objective.text: `agentos resume` without `--task` must resume the real checkpoint task instead of a slug of the objective text (false "no checkpoint"): the objective's task when it has checkpoints, else the only task with checkpoints; several → list the ids with `--task` hints (exit 2); none → today's view with the derived id labelled. A checkpoint that failed to save must not hide the last usable one, and a failing check in a saved one must stay visible. `doctor` must not fail a clone with no vault bound when `canonical: workspace` (`canonical: vault` still fails). A `core.autocrlf=true` checkout must not report Brain records or agent cards as changed.

acceptance.text:
- After `agentos checkpoint --task <id> --next "<action>"`, `agentos status`, `agentos context <engine> --task <id>` and `agentos resume --task <id>` present exactly one current next action: the most recently saved one.
- Older or contradicting next-action text in handoff.md or tasks.md is not presented as current; the next agent can tell it is superseded.
- Nothing is silently deleted.

progress: Bare resume/context resolve the checkpoint task (one -> resumed as --task, several -> listed, exit 2, none -> labelled); failed saves show the last usable checkpoint as OLDER state; status shows failing checks and checkpoint problems; doctor unbound vault with canonical: workspace is a warning; CRLF-neutral Brain and agent-card hashes.
